objective: Check all parts of a statement against evidence, separating support, contradiction and missing information.
theory: AI-created IELTS-style written reasoning preparation, not an official Reading test. TRUE means the whole statement is supported; FALSE means contradiction; NOT GIVEN means neither supported nor contradicted. Do not substitute outside knowledge or plausible guesses. Missing detail is not automatically false.
strategy: Check who/what/when/quantity/comparison/cause. Give textual evidence for TRUE/FALSE; identify the missing detail for NOT GIVEN.

worked_example.prompt: Leo cycles to work every weekday. Claim: He cycles because he wants to save money.
worked_example.reasoning: Frequency is stated; his reason is not.

guided.prompt: A workshop starts at 2 p.m. and finishes at 3 p.m. Claim: It lasts two hours. Choose TFNG and explain.

independent.prompt: Text: The gallery opened in 2004. Its first exhibition displayed paintings by local artists. Statement: The gallery's first exhibition featured local artists' paintings. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.
Text: The walking tour starts at 9 a.m. and ends at 11 a.m. Statement: The walking tour lasts three hours. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.
Text: Priya works at the visitor centre and gives visitors maps. Statement: Priya enjoys her job. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.
Text: The cafe serves breakfast every day except Monday. Statement: The cafe serves breakfast on Monday. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.
Text: Every hostel room has a desk. Statement: All hostel rooms contain a desk. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.
Text: The council built a cycle path beside the river last year. Statement: It cost less than the council expected. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.
Text: Train tickets are cheaper online than at the station. Statement: Tickets cost more at the station than online. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.
Text: Nora has lived in town for six years and travels to work by bus. Statement: Nora moved to town because of her job. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.

Text: The library closes at 6 p.m. on weekdays and 4 p.m. on Saturdays. Statement: The library closes at the same time on those days. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.
Text: The hotel provides free Wi-Fi in all bedrooms. Statement: Guests can use bedroom Wi-Fi without payment. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.
Text: The market sells fruit and vegetables grown by local farmers. Statement: The market also sells imported cheese. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.
Text: Only adults may join the evening photography course. Statement: Children may join the course. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.
Text: The pool reopened after repairs on 12 June. Statement: Repairs happened before the pool reopened. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.
Text: Tickets for the performance sold out within two days. Statement: It sold tickets faster than last year's performance. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.
Text: The village has two schools: one primary and one secondary. Statement: The village has three schools. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.
Text: Passengers must book the airport bus in advance. Statement: Advance booking is required. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.
Text: Maya chose a hotel close to the beach. Her room had a balcony. Statement: Her room had a sea view. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.
Text: The museum is closed to visitors throughout January. Statement: Visitors can enter during January. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.
Text: Visitors receive a printed map at no extra charge. Statement: There is no additional fee for a printed map. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.
Text: The shuttle leaves every thirty minutes. Statement: It leaves every fifteen minutes. Choose TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN; give evidence or identify the missing detail.

q1.explanation: First exhibition and local artists are directly stated.

q2.explanation: The stated times give two hours.

q3.explanation: Feelings about the job are not stated.

q5.explanation: Every and all express the same coverage.

q6.explanation: No cost or expected budget is supplied.

q8.explanation: The reason for moving is not stated.

q11.explanation: Cheese is neither included nor excluded.

q16.explanation: Must book and required have the same meaning.

q17.explanation: A balcony near the beach does not establish a sea view.

q19.explanation: No extra charge directly supports it.

coach_only.rubric: Assess only the displayed/submitted scope. Separate grammar, spelling, punctuation and fulfilment. Coach-created support practice; no IELTS band, CEFR or mastery claim. Preserve initial responses and post-feedback revisions.
